criteria.requirement: Implement tenacity.history.RetryHistory(max_entries=20) with wrap(fn), immutable records snapshot and clear(). Wrap actual sync/async target attempts, recording frozen AttemptRecord(sequence,elapsed,succeeded,exception_type) on each completed success or BaseException, preserving return identity and reraising the same exception. Bound storage, retain monotonic unique sequence across clear, protect concurrent snapshot and append, and preserve function metadata. Store no arguments, result values, exception objects/messages or tracebacks. Integrate by passing wrapped target into existing retry controllers; do not claim automatic per-call isolation or record an unawaited coroutine as a successful attempt.
